// CASE dart_inorder_named_param expect=pass
Future<void> inOrder<T>(
  Iterable<T> items,
  Future<void> Function(T item) step, {
  required String reason,
}) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    await step(item);
  }
}

// CASE dart_worker expect=pass
Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = List<R?>.filled(items.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(
    List.generate(width, (_) async {
      while (next < items.length) {
        final index = next++;
        results[index] = await operation(items[index]);
      }
    }),
  );
  return results.cast<R>();
}

// CASE dart_call_reason expect=pass
Future<void> migrate(
  List<String> rows,
  Future<void> Function(String) save,
) async {
  await inOrder(
    rows,
    save,
    reason: 'Each update reads the row the previous step wrote',
  );
}
